lines.en: I walk forward over the sand.
My steps are heavy.
Each step sinks a little.
My plates knock together.
I head toward the hills.
Sand slides away under my tread.
I look down at the ground.
I go around a boulder.
I come toward you again.
My tail sweeps a fan of sand.
I stop and take a breath.
I stand on the dune.
There is a layer of dust on my plates.
Something in the distance glints.
I wonder whether it is ore.
My vents let out a slow breath.
I look at the sun.
I lower my head to gnaw the ore vein.
My shadow lies short on the sand.
I wait for the wind to ease.
Sand piles up at my feet.
I stop, treads still warm.

lines.zh: 我抬起装甲的脖子看你。
lines.en: I lift my armored neck to look at you.
What are you doing in the desert?
This armor was smelted from ore.
I blink slowly.
You carry no smell of ore.
You do not look like an enemy.
I do not want to fight either.
We look at each other.
You stepped on the sand.
I hear a stone roll.
The sand blast hides me.
You do not look ready to fight.
I set my foot down too.
Let us leave it at that.
A dull clang sounds inside my shell.
My treads slip back half a step.
A mark shows on my armor.
I lift a foot and set it down.
Sand sticks to the wound.
I shake my head and shed a layer of sand.
I eat minerals in the desert and stand firm.
That was not heavy.
I watch you through my armor seams.
I'll remember this dent.
Is that stone?
Desert minerals. That is what I want.
What I want is ore.
I lower my head and smell iron ore.
This stone is too hard to bite.
I push it aside with my drill.
Keep that ore for yourself.
I prefer what is underground.
There is no ore smell on your hands.
You hit my armor plate.
I didn't shift an inch.
My treads shove you back three steps.
My armor is solid.
You hit me again.
This time I give a little too.
Iron on iron; neither of us hurt.
You should go around.
There are others in the desert.
They are underground.
We rarely meet.
I walk this line alone.
The wind smooths out my prints.
I look at the far hills.
The stones rattle.
I eat minerals, and my feet stay firm.
The day is hot.
I stop in a sheltered place.
Ore is what I eat.
This one is ore.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，不重，沙还能再喷。
lines.en: I weigh it; not heavy, sand can spray again.
I set it on my back.
It slides off.
Four feet on the ground, steady.
This ore goes into my hold.
Not ore; I drop it.
You dropped it; I will not take it.

lines.zh: 我脚下扬起的沙，像一层雾。
lines.en: The sand I kick up hangs like mist.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的路了，沙在我脚下翻。
lines.en: You are in my way; the sand turns under my feet.
My plates lift.
The sand churns under me.
My drill turns; I roll in.
You retreat up the dune.
The dune will give way.
My treads grind forward a block.
Treads crush the dune ridge; I've arrived.
The sand slows my feet.
It slows yours as well.
My treads swing toward your flank.
I halt on the dune.
I am very near.
The wind covers your tracks.
I can find you without seeing.
The ground is shaking.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上去，沙子进嘴了。
lines.en: I ram you head on; sand fills my mouth.
My forefoot comes down.
My plates drive you back.
You are driven into the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙，被我扬成一片。
lines.en: I throw up a whole sheet of desert sand.
Drill retracted, I back off a little.
I steady all four feet.
I charge again.
The second gets through.
My treads grind out of the sand.

lines.zh: 这块地，我踩过就算我的。
lines.en: I stepped here, so it is my ground.

lines.zh: 我的甲第一次晒到太阳。
lines.en: My plates catch the sun for the first time.
I shake sand from my armor seams.
I test how hard the ground is.
Hard; good.

lines.zh: 我踩着沙往前走，每一步都陷一点。
lines.en: I walk the sand, sinking a little each step.
The wind smooths my prints.
I lower my head and smell ore.

lines.zh: 我朝矿脉的方向碾过去。
lines.en: I roll toward the ore vein.
I can stay here a long while.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，我往沙里退。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates and I back into the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，甲磕在石上。
lines.en: I roll down the dune and my plates hit stone.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water covers my back and I cannot lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开沙子，我被埋了一半。
lines.en: The blast throws up sand and half buries me.

lines.zh: 咒光打过来，我的甲面发烫。
lines.en: Spell-light hits and my armor grows hot.
I have not had ore in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，玻璃化成一片。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and it turns to glass.
There is no sand to stand on in the void.
